The first release of FlexTip, a tooltip addon for WoW Forever.

## Install
1. Download **FlexTip-Forever.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Copy the `FlexTip` folder into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.
3. Start the game and make sure FlexTip is ticked in the AddOns list.

Type `/ftip` in game to open the options.

## What it does
- **Move** the tooltip. Drag an anchor anywhere, follow the mouse cursor, or keep Blizzard's spot. Tooltips from the game world and from UI frames can each go somewhere different.
- **Resize** it from 0.5x to 2x, with a slider, the mouse wheel or a corner grip.
- **Collapse** player and NPC tooltips to their first rows. Hold Shift to see the full tooltip.
- **Choose what shows**:
  - name: realm, title
  - guild: the row, the rank
  - level row: level, race or creature type
  - more rows: class, faction, PvP, NPC title
  - quests: to pick up or turn in, objectives
  - rows from other addons
- **Works with Questie.** Quest progress stays when you hide other rows or collapse the tooltip, inside instances too.
- **More options:**
  - class-colored names and border
  - background opacity
  - hide the health bar
  - hide tooltips in combat
  - an optional "Target:" row

## Notes
- Built for WoW Forever (Interface 16001). It also loads on retail.
- Please report problems under [Issues](https://github.com/Andremijo/FlexTip/issues).
